scenes.basis: 22:1 "the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching"; Judas "talked with the chief priests and captains" (22:4) - the festival city is unnamed in Luke
22:10 "when you have entered into the city" - the unnamed city is Jerusalem, the Passover setting (22:1, 7)
22:14 "he sat down with the twelve apostles" - the upper room (22:12) in the unnamed city
22:39 "He came out, and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives"; the arrest (22:47-53) follows there
22:54 "They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest's house" - in the city
22:63 "The men who held Jesus mocked him" - the high priest's house of 22:54
